punk.name: Punk Hazard
punk.description: One side is continuously burned; the other is continuously chilled.

budokai.name: Tenkaichi Budokai
budokai.description: The first five slots fight simultaneous one-on-one duels. Win three duels to win.

dangai.name: Dangai
dangai.description: The Kōtotsu sweeps through every five seconds, dealing 20% of maximum HP to every unit.

valley.name: Valley of the End
valley.description: Each team’s strongest member, measured by modified starting stats, fights a deciding duel.

colosseum.name: Colosseum
colosseum.description: After six seconds, Silver Chariot Requiem shuffles positions within and between teams. Original teams return after battle.

hope.name: Hope’s Peak Academy
hope.description: The first unit to kill another unit is immediately executed.

itomori.name: Itomori
itomori.description: Tiamat strikes after 20 seconds. The team with the greater sum of remaining HP percentages wins. Ties favor your team.
